scope: Ablate the previously uncommitted P0/P1 and P2/P3 increment after committing it; preserve supported editor behavior. No Zed SSH acceptance.

changes: Construct one resolved expression replacement at an explicit invocation offset; remove empty/mutable initialization states and multi-rule indices.
Remove uncalled search-only, comment-rule, debug and workspace-traversal entry points. ide-ssr is publish=false; repository call-site search found only Analysis as production client.
IDE owns file traversal; pass FileText and return Vec<TextEdit>, avoiding a cloned workspace file map and single-key result maps.
Remove SsrMatches/PlaceholderMatch wrappers, dead nested matches/depth/comment/range fields, and mismatch strings consumed only by the removed debug API.
Require a replacement expression, parse each side once, validate replacement placeholders from the already parsed map; remove type/pattern/item parsing paths that the request rejected.
Borrow matching placeholder metadata; remove unused url/smol_str dependencies.

Keep binding identity, placeholder constraints, comments, precedence, selection-before-overlap, inactive-branch filtering, include-instance rejection, cancellation, versioned previews and whole-file parse validation.
Reuse the already joined parameter string instead of reconstructing it through ListFormatting/write_list.
Remove the now unconstructed SeparatorTactic::Never variant. Keep CST extraction and the existing layout tactic.

negative_controls.name: without-overload-types
without-binding-identity
without-comment-guard
without-conversion-scope

ssr.method: Release binaries; same CPU; 3 alternating paired runs, 12 requests per process (one cold, 11 warm), 10 files / 1000 matches. All edits (file IDs, ranges and replacements) hashed in stable file order; assert 1000 edits. Intermediate is API simplification before removing the remaining match/capture wrappers.
ssr.timing_caution: The first final paired run crossed a clear wall-time regime shift (both binaries moved from about 65-68 ms to 49-52 ms). Its pooled median is not an effect estimate. Post-gate repeated alternating runs are recorded separately; no stable speedup is claimed.

completion.method: Each candidate removes only one score bonus; release fixed 3000-reference sample, absolute sail-riscv path, same CPU, 3 runs per binary. Candidates restored; both bonuses retained.

semantic_prefilter.method: 5 fresh databases, 200 unrelated functions plus one target; identical missing-field result asserted; trace infer events. Restore exact span/file prefilter.

formatter.method: Temporarily dump every raw formatter output before safety fallback in both variants; compare bytes, token preservation, parse success and idempotence. Restore probe-only instrumentation. Old string-based extraction demonstrably turns code following // into comment text.

retained_designs.reason: Inference selects equal-arity typed/dependent overloads; removal fails two protocol regressions. Keep incomplete-call arity fallback.

Semantic callable scope/type checks prevent nonexistent or incompatible unsigned/signed edits; removal fails the apply/recheck regression. Keep existing diagnostic-owned fixes pipeline and suppression of unsafe duplicate/shadow rename suggestions.
Reintroducing the cross-file spelling fallback invents unrelated_name: at an unresolved helper call. Retain semantic identity and local fallback.
Both small relevance bonuses improve measured rank; single scope query and cached cursor token avoid repeated lookup. No new ranking layer added.

WorkspaceStatus is an immutable request snapshot of roots/config/load errors; eliminating it would spread GlobalState access. Build revision works in archive, nested archive, checkout, worktree and explicit override cases; smoke rerun passed.
Keep ResolutionScope and ResolvedPattern for one-time invocation-scope binding resolution shared by pattern and replacement; needed by the identity guard, not speculative workspace state.

Keep project-aware fixtures, oracle freshness preflight, release quality reports and branch/rename/delete/generated-file recovery regressions. These establish scope and detect stale diagnostics; they are not redundant production abstractions.
Keep the list-layout tactic because multiline parameters and width decisions are meaningful; only redundant output assembly was removed.

limits: This is focused ablation, not a new upstream conformance or mutation campaign; prior corpus quality counts are not relabeled as current measurements.
Timing is local microbenchmark evidence, not a Zed SSH latency claim or general performance guarantee.
Formatter corpus skips three already unparsable sources; output equivalence covers the 214 valid files.
Four wrapper/search-only parser tests were removed with those unsupported APIs; five actual replacement parser safety tests and all protocol SSR regressions remain.
Unused Rust APIs removed from the non-published internal crate; experimental/ssr request/response schema is unchanged.
